phase_caps.note: 20 Hz sample differences, each leg padded with its rest samples at both ends; 'wait' samples use the transit caps

workload.note: busy_lower_bound = max over robots of its own motion + holds + margins in THIS plan (no waits): it depends on the allocation, so 1.00 does not mean balanced; mean_busy = sum(busy) / N is the allocation-independent reference (perfect balance of this plan's work)

weld_stays.note: the tool stays on the weld point while the robot waits for other robots (the lift-off is the start of the next leg); informational

group_order_check.note: per_arm orders the groups within each robot only; global plans each group as a cell-wide phase

window.certified_note: certified lower bound of the continuous minimum over the window (time between samples and shifts between the grid shifts; branch and bound, within ~0.5 mm of the true minimum in the tested cases); None: the sampled minimum is at the detection cap, certified >= hull_min only

skew_tolerance.note: per_robot: largest constant lag (late) / lead (early) of one robot against all others that keeps each criterion at every smaller shift; '>= x' = holds over the whole scan

continuous.method: piecewise-linear joint paths between the timeline's knots; provable chain displacement bound per point; interval bound (g_a + g_b - L) / 2; bisection to min_dt (trajgen.certify, docs/p3_tgcert.md)

joint_limits.note: certified by convexity: between two knots every joint moves linearly, so a path whose knots are within the limits stays within them (knots checked by the sampled verdict)

arm_arm_spheres.note: corrected spheres, clearance must stay > gate

arm_arm_hull.note: MuJoCo hull distance >= hull_min (capped at the 0.080 m detection band)
